contract: Animate from accepted model events. Hit regions never inherit squash, shake or decorative translation. Pause/hidden/unmount suspend all tracks.

pickup.still: Show carried object and update inventory immediately.

walk.still: Move between graph nodes on action; preserve route cost.

recover.still: Use current expression and a static recovery indicator.

breath.still: Step-based expand/settle text and static guide, optional.

noise.still: Static source mark; do not shake the screen.

completion.still: Static success spark; focus the next action.

audio.pause: Stop/fade nodes and retain logical play state; never resume without user consent.
audio.warning: Individual WAV peaks are bounded; runtime mixing still needs a master limiter and volume control.
